noteDetail: pricePerHour is the public-lot hourly price from the City Parking price list (checked 2026-10-17). Zone A/A0 first hour is 75 MKD, and A0 has no price here. scripts/bake-parking.ts copies these prices onto the baked zone polygons (data/static/parking-zones.geojson); the zone geometry comes from the zone list, not from this file.
